title: Design Kubernetes incident remediation agent
description: Design a safe alert-driven agent that consumes Alertmanager and Kubernetes crash-loop signals, dispatches diagnostics/remediation through the existing agents control plane, and reports progress to Discord.

title: Long-running agents: stop conditions + budgets
description: Idea: Long-running agents (à la Herbert's stop conditions) should also be given a budget. Combine stop conditions with an explicit budget so agents can run autonomously and terminate deterministically.
